responsibility: Defines rustc’s central type-system layer: it owns the `TyCtxt` and query infrastructure, the interned representations of types, consts, generic arguments, lists, ADTs, traits, associated items, instances, closures, vtables, layouts, and type-checking artifacts; provides the operations over those representations such as folding, visiting, walking, relating, matching, substituting, region erasure, normalization, inhabitedness and abstract-const analysis, opaque-type and rvalue-scope handling, cast/coercion and binding metadata, and assorted utilities; supports persistence and compiler mechanics through interning metadata, stable hashing, parameterization, structural impls, and encoding/decoding; and supplies the printing, error-rendering, diagnostics, and provider wiring that make the whole `ty` subsystem available to later compiler stages.
